title: Add a profile avatar menu beside logout

pr.title: Add a profile avatar menu beside logout
pr.body:
## Summary
- Add a profile avatar beside logout. Opening it lists account, role, record, and a link to the scoreboard, and hides the top-bar greeting.
- Gate the menu with the `profile-avatar-menu` control point (off by default; on in local development).
- Record menu opens, record-load success, record-load errors, and load time.

## Test plan
- [ ] Sign in with the flag off and confirm the greeting and logout button are unchanged, with no avatar.
- [ ] Sign in with the flag on and confirm the greeting is gone and the avatar sits beside logout.
- [ ] Open the avatar and confirm account, role, and record appear, then follow the scoreboard link.
- [ ] Close the menu with Escape and with a click outside it.
- [ ] Confirm a successful open emits `arcade_web_profile_menu_opens_total`, `arcade_web_profile_menu_load_success_total`, and `arcade_web_profile_menu_load_ms`.
- [ ] Confirm a failed scoreboard load shows "unavailable" and emits `arcade_web_profile_menu_load_errors_total`.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
